entities.summary: Georges d'Aubusson de La Feuillade was a French Catholic clergyman under Louis XIV, who served as Archbishop of Embrun (1649–1668), then Bishop of Metz (1669–1697). He also held a number of diplomatic posts and actively supported measures against French Huguenots; he died in May 1697 and was buried in Metz Cathedral.
